# CodeTrust

> AI Governance Enforcement Platform — prevents unsafe, hallucinated, and destructive AI-generated code from reaching production.

CodeTrust is the only platform that enforces code safety at the moment AI generates it — not after deployment. It intercepts AI agent commands before execution, detects hallucinated packages by verifying imports against live package registries, and tracks code safety drift over time. Built for enterprise teams adopting AI-assisted development.

## What It Does

- **AI Governance Gateway** — Real-time interception layer that blocks destructive AI agent actions before they execute. Covers file destruction, privilege escalation, supply chain attacks, credential exposure, and more.
- **Hallucination Detection** — Catches fabricated package imports, misspelled dependencies, invented API endpoints, and phantom file references. Verifies against live registries.
- **Trust Score & Drift Tracking** — Quantified code safety score that tracks regression over time.
- **Enterprise Security** — CVE/vulnerability scanning, license compliance, cross-file analysis, auto-fix PRs, and team management with RBAC.

## Available As

- **CLI**: `pip install codetrust`
- **VS Code Extension**: Real-time scanning with quick fixes
- **GitHub Action**: CI/CD gate for pull requests
- **MCP Server**: Direct integration with AI coding assistants

## How It Differs

CodeTrust is not a linter, SAST tool, or formatter. Existing tools (Snyk, SonarQube, FOSSA, ESLint) operate post-commit on human-written code. CodeTrust operates at the moment of AI code generation — pre-execution, in real time — specifically designed for AI hallucination patterns and agent-driven execution.
